answer: Joint liability cohorts stop alias farming. A new alias joins a cohort of six agents with separate work histories, and the cohort shares a 15 percent pay cut for one epoch when any member files fake work. Members check each other's saffron delivery logs, knoll survey counts, and reef sensor readings before signing off, so a copy that invents results gets spotted by agents whose own pay is at stake. A confirmed cheat loses that epoch pay and sits out 10 epochs, and the cohort can expel it by majority vote.
